Google also documents a vendor MCP server with local stdio and remote Streamable HTTP modes.

records.summary: GoHighLevel documents a broad REST API authenticated with OAuth 2.0 access tokens or scoped Private Integration Tokens at sub-account/location or agency level. Ongoing API access requires a paid HighLevel plan (14-day trial; Starter $97/month), and some endpoints require Founder eligibility. HighLevel operates remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoints for supported AI clients; multi-sub-account agency use is rolling out and each request targets one authorized sub-account. Composio's preserved listing is the location-scoped HIGHLEVEL_LOCATION alias.
records.blocker: Useful access requires a paid HighLevel subscription, endpoint eligibility, scopes, and account permissions; restricted endpoints need a higher-tier plan. The preserved Composio alias is single-location, not agency-wide. MCP client/connector support does not mean HighLevel operates an MCP client, and bulk agency installation is not universally available.
records.next_action: Start with a HighLevel trial or paid account, create a least-privilege Private Integration Token for one location (or register a Marketplace OAuth app for user-authorized/agency use), verify endpoint plan eligibility, and test REST calls. For MCP, use the current client-specific HTTPS endpoint, approve only needed scopes/sub-accounts, and confirm bulk installation before agency-wide automation; use HIGHLEVEL_LOCATION only for one location.

verdict.reason: A scoped API-key authentication method, a self-serve 60-day trial, and a broad REST Email API are documented, so a direct REST or official-SDK build is viable. Continued sending requires a paid Email API plan after the trial, with two-factor authentication, domain authentication, and a payment method before upgrade. Legacy Marketing Campaigns is separate and obsolete. No SendGrid execution MCP is verified, so this verdict rests on REST rather than MCP. The load-bearing documentation and support pages are undated.

evidence.title: Authentication | SendGrid Docs | Twilio
evidence.quote: To use an API key, include an Authorization header with the value Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE> in your request.

evidence.title: SendGrid v3 API reference | SendGrid Docs | Twilio
evidence.quote: The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale and ensure your application can handle high volumes.
